item: main green again after the two Dependabot merges: sqlcipher3 0.6.5 qualified with its lock, registry and smoke pin; ruff 0.17.4's four new findings fixed and the ratchet lowered to 411
summary: Found by the 2026-11-11 quality audit of the week's merges. BEFORE: #1873 (sqlcipher3 <0.6.5 to <0.6.6) and #1874 (ruff 0.17.3 to 0.17.4) were merged with their PR runs red, and main failed two gates. (1) tests/test_external_freshness.py::test_sqlcipher3_range_in_pyproject_matches_the_registry_and_keeps_its_ceiling: pyproject lifted the ceiling while the registry kept 0.6.5, so a fresh pip install took sqlcipher3 0.6.5 (SQLCipher 4.20.0, SQLite 3.54.1), a release nobody had qualified against the damage lane, while requirements.lock and the sqlcipher-smoke job stayed on 0.6.4. (2) scripts/ruff_ratchet.py: ruff 0.17.4 reads 415 on the same tree (ceiling 412), four new SIM102 findings. NOW: 0.6.5 is qualified the way the registry's refresh step says: tests/test_poisoned_connection.py and tests/test_database_verify_pages.py (with test_sqlcipher, test_release_after_damage and test_bundle_damaged_read: 166 passed, 2 skipped) run on 0.6.5, whose engine measures as corrupt, the 4.19 behaviour; the registry pin reads floor 0.6.2, verified 0.6.5, ceiling 0.6.6; requirements.lock pins 0.6.5 with the 100 sha256 hashes PyPI lists for it; the sqlcipher-smoke job installs 0.6.5; EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md and the pyproject comment say so. The four SIM102 sites (src/backup/stream_backup.py janitor, and three AST scans in tests) are merged into single conditions, each the last branch of its chain so no fall-through changes; the ratchet reads 411 and its ceiling moves to 411. The registry's CI-pin note records ruff==0.17.4. Release-notes line: «The app now accepts sqlcipher3 0.6.5 (SQLCipher 4.20), checked against the damaged-database tests first.»
